content.subject: Causeway — a music festival on Skerrow Island
facts: Name: Causeway — a one-day music festival on Skerrow Island
Date: Saturday 19 June 2027
The island is reached on foot over a 1.2 km tidal causeway
Causeway open for arrivals 09:40–13:10 and for departures 22:15–01:30 (that day's tide times)
Nobody crosses outside those windows; the harbour boat is for emergencies only
Capacity: 900 people
Tickets: £54 adult, £27 for ages 12–17, free under 12; on sale 1 March 2027
Two stages: the Boathouse (indoors, 220 people) and the Field (outdoors)
Field line-up: The Lantern Choir, Mara Quist, Seven Herons, Low Orbit Brass
Boathouse line-up: Ada Fenwick (solo cello), Tomasz & the Weir, Kelp, Ruth Ono Trio
The last set ends at 21:45 so everyone reaches the causeway in time
No single-use plastic on the island: bring a cup, or buy an enamel one for £6
Food from two island kitchens; cash and card
Organised by the Skerrow Island Trust, a volunteer charity; profits go to repairing the sea wall
Fourth year of the festival, first held in 2024
Wear boots: parts of the causeway are wet sand and seaweed

concept.zh: 刚从晒图室取出的工程图纸：带分区编号的图框、右下角的标题栏、尺寸线与箭头、修订表、“第 3 张 / 共 12 张”。蓝晒、氨熏晒图或描图纸上的单线字，一切都被标注、编号、可追溯。
concept.en: The engineering drawing as it leaves the print room: a border frame with zone markers, a title block in the bottom-right corner, dimension lines with arrowheads, a revision table, “Sheet 3 of 12”. Cyanotype, diazo or drafting vellum with single-stroke lettering — everything labelled, numbered and traceable.

references: ISO 5457 / ISO 7200 drawing-sheet frames and title blocks
ISO 3098 lettering and Leroy / Rotring stencil lettering templates
Apollo-era engineering drawings (North American Aviation, Grumman Lunar Module)
Cyanotype blueprints and Pellet-process prints, 1870s–1940s
GB/T 14689 图纸幅面与格式 and GB/T 14691 长仿宋体 lettering

tokens.grid: Drawing sheet with a 24px border frame; the frame is divided into zones — columns 1–8 across the top and bottom, rows A–F down both sides — mapped to CSS grid tracks; everything inside snaps to an 8px drafting grid.
tokens.radius: 0 everywhere. The only circles are balloon callouts (28px, border-radius 50%) and centre marks.
tokens.border: Frame: 2px solid ink outer line + 1px zone ticks; object lines 1.5px; dimension and leader lines 1px; hidden lines 1px dashed (6px/3px); centre lines 1px dash-dot (stroke-dasharray 12 3 2 3).
tokens.shadow: none. Depth is shown only by section hatching: 45° 1px lines at a 6px pitch.

must: A visible drawing frame with zone markers and a title block holding title, drawing number, scale or date, and “SHEET n OF N”.
All labels uppercase in the ISO lettering sizes; every number carries its unit.
At least one dimension line or balloon callout carries a real fact from the brief.
A revision table or revision letter is present and consistent across the page.
mustNot: No rendered 3D isometrics with gradients or glows — line drawing only.
No sci-fi HUD styling (neon, scanlines, hexagon grids); this is paper.
No decorative arrows: every arrowhead terminates a dimension or a leader.

voice.description: 观察者的记录：带日期、时间、度量和第一手细节，克制、不评价。
voice.example: 06:40 — 窗内温度 31°C，面团第二次发酵完成（目测体积 ×2）。

layout.name: Exploded assembly
layout.description: An exploded view: the topic broken into parts floating along centre lines, each part ballooned and listed in a parts list beside it.
layout.grid: Two zones: 8-column field for the exploded view (parts positioned along a 30° axis), 4-column parts list; 8px grid; 28px balloons.
structure: Header strip: drawing title in wide caps, DWG NO. right-aligned
Exploded view: 4–8 parts (content blocks) spaced along dash-dot centre lines with balloon numbers
Parts list table aligned to the balloon numbers
One dimension line spanning the whole view carrying the key figure (size, price, date range)
Title block with approval signatures

anchor.name: General arrangement
anchor.description: A large orthographic diagram (front / top / side views) of the subject in simple SVG shapes with dimensions, filling ~70% of the first screen.

type.name: Architects Daughter + IBM Plex Sans Condensed
type.notes: Architects Daughter for titles and callouts, UPPERCASE ONLY with 0.08em tracking at 24–48px — the hand lettering of a draughtsman on vellum. IBM Plex Sans Condensed 400/600 for notes and schedules at 15px/1.35. IBM Plex Mono 500 for drawing numbers, part numbers and dimensions; thousands separated by a thin space (“1 200”).

palette.name: Drafting vellum
palette.usage: Cool translucent vellum ground; graphite-black linework and lettering; red reserved for revision clouds, redlines and “VOID” stamps; steel blue (accent2) for dimension figures; grey rule for the 8px construction grid at low visibility.

density.description: 信息密集，多栏并行；用细线和对齐建立秩序，首屏就能看到 3 个以上信息块。

motion.name: Zone locate
motion.description: Hovering a cross-reference (“SEE C4”) highlights the matching zone markers on the frame and draws a 1px crosshair to that zone.
motion.reduced: Highlight the zone markers in accent without the crosshair.

motif.name: Revision clouds & triangles
motif.description: A scalloped SVG cloud around whatever changed plus a triangle holding the revision letter, matching a row in the revision table.

surface.name: Drafting vellum
surface.description: Translucent, slightly milky vellum with faint eraser smudges.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 70% 30%, rgba(255,255,255,.5), transparent 40%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 80%, rgba(0,0,0,.035), transparent 35%);

twist.description: 至少一处使用竖排文字（中文 writing-mode: vertical-rl）或旋转 90° 的标签作为结构元素。

concept.zh: 测绘局出版的地形图：等高线一圈圈收紧，图廓上刻满坐标刻度，图例方框、比例尺和出版说明整齐地排在图边。水系是蓝色斜体，等高线是赭色，林地是淡绿色块——每一种颜色都是一层数据。
concept.en: The survey office’s topographic sheet: contours tightening ring by ring, grid references ticked along the neat-line, legend boxes, scale bar and imprint lined up in the margin. Water is blue italic, contours ochre, woodland a pale green tint — every colour is a data layer.

references: Ordnance Survey 1:50 000 Landranger and 1:25 000 Explorer sheets
USGS 7.5-minute topographic quadrangles
swisstopo Landeskarte der Schweiz 1:25 000
Eduard Imhof — Cartographic Relief Presentation (1965)
国家测绘局 1:5 万地形图

tokens.grid: Map sheet: a neat-line frame inset 48px from the viewport; inside, a grid square every 96px drawn as hairlines with two-digit references at both ends of every line in the margin; content panels snap to whole grid squares.
tokens.radius: 0. Only symbols are round (spot heights, survey points); trig points are triangles.
tokens.border: Neat-line: 1px ink inner line + 6px ink outer line, 8px apart. Grid lines 1px var(--rule); legend boxes 1px ink; scale bar segments 1px ink outline.
tokens.shadow: none. Relief, if any, is a hillshade tint inside the map field — never a drop shadow on UI.

must: A neat-line frame with coordinate ticks and labels on at least two sides.
A legend explains every symbol and colour used; a scale bar appears on the page.
Water-related or secondary names are italic; colours are assigned by layer, never decoratively.
mustNot: No satellite imagery, web-map pins or rounded map controls.
No random squiggles: contours are concentric, non-crossing and evenly stepped.
No more than four layer colours plus ink.

voice.description: 把主题写成词典词条：词头、注音/词性、编号释义、例句、参见。
voice.example: 第四巷 dì sì xiàng ⟨名⟩ ① 一条只有一家面包店的巷子。

layout.name: Legend-led
layout.description: The legend is the page: content arranged as entries of a large two-column key, with a small locator map inset at the top right.
layout.grid: 8 col; legend entries in 2 columns, each entry = a 48px symbol cell + text; locator inset 3 col × 3 rows with its own neat-line.
structure: Series header band: series name, sheet number, edition
Locator inset map with the current area outlined
Legend sections (roads & paths / water / vegetation / buildings) relabelled as the facts’ categories
Reference table: grid reference for each item, e.g. "SD 284 093" format
Margin notes and publication imprint

anchor.name: Contour field
anchor.description: The first screen is a field of contours with the title set as a feature name along the slope (letter-spaced on an SVG textPath).

type.name: Barlow Condensed + Barlow + Azeret Mono
type.notes: Place names in Barlow Condensed: settlements upright 600; area names letter-spaced +0.15em across their feature; water names italic. Spot heights and grid numbers in Azeret Mono 11px tabular. Hierarchy by size and spacing, not colour.

palette.name: Cyanotype field copy
palette.usage: Prussian-blue blueprint of the field sheet: all line work and text in white/ink; muted for grid labels; yellow survey-crayon accent2 only for the current-location mark and corrections.

density.description: 信息密集，多栏并行；用细线和对齐建立秩序，首屏就能看到 3 个以上信息块。

motion.name: Contour plot
motion.description: Contours draw themselves on first load via stroke-dashoffset, innermost ring first, at constant plotter speed; 40ms stagger per contour.

motif.name: Scale bar
motif.description: Alternating ink/paper segmented bar (0–1–2 km) with "1:25 000" above and small numbers under each division.

surface.name: Woodland stipple
surface.description: Vegetation areas as a regular stipple of small dots on the panel tint.
surface.css: background-color: var(--panel); background-image: radial-gradient(color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink) 25%, transparent) 1px, transparent 1.4px); background-size: 10px 8px;

twist.description: 强调色在全页最多出现 3 处；其余一切只用 ink / paper / rule。

concept.zh: 街角手作小店的温度：牛皮纸、橡皮章、手写标签、麻绳、木刻版画小插图，以及歪一点的手绘边框。不完美是证据——说明真的有人一件件做出来、一个个写上去。
concept.en: The warmth of a corner shop that makes things by hand: kraft paper, rubber stamps, handwritten labels, twine, linocut vignettes and slightly crooked hand-drawn borders. The imperfection is evidence — someone really made each thing and wrote each label.

references: Edward Bawden linocuts and shop posters (1950s–1980s)
Whole Earth Catalog hand-pasted layouts (1968–1972)
Hand-written POP price cards in Japanese 雑貨 shops
Kraft-paper bakery bags with rubber-stamped logos
Farmers’ market chalkboards

tokens.grid: Loose 6-column grid, 24px gutter, 32px margins; at most one element in three sits ±1–2° off-axis or ±4px off-grid; 8px baseline for body only.
tokens.radius: 0–3px on paper tags; tag corners cut with clip-path; hand-drawn borders are SVG paths, not border-radius.
tokens.border: Hand-drawn: SVG strokes 1.5–2.5px with slight wobble (feTurbulence + feDisplacementMap, scale 2–3); 2px dashed "stitch" lines for sewn edges.
tokens.shadow: Paper only: 1px 2px 0 rgba(60,40,20,.25) under taped or pinned labels; no blurred shadows.

must: At least one genuinely hand-made element: hand-lettered display, a stamp with uneven ink, or a wobbly hand-drawn border.
Prices, hours and items are written as labels or tags, not as a generic table.
Illustrations, if any, are one-colour linocut-style and depict real items from the facts.
mustNot: No farmhouse clip-art clichés: "Live Laugh Love" script, mason-jar icons, wood-plank photo backgrounds.
No handwriting face for body paragraphs — labels and titles only.
No glossy gradients, no perfect geometric icon sets.
Do not tilt everything: at most one element in three is off-axis.

voice.description: 黄历/年鉴口吻：宜忌、节令、方位，短句并列，带一点古意但信息准确。
voice.example: 宜：早起、趁热。忌：周一来访。

layout.name: Kraft bag
layout.description: The page is a kraft bag: a big rubber-stamp logo on the front, a paper label band wrapped around, the back panel printed with details.
layout.grid: 8 col; stamp 4 col wide in the first screen; label band full width rotated -2°; back panel in 2 columns of 4, 24px gutter.
structure: Front: stamp logo + a handwritten note on a small label
Label band: one-line statement across the width
Back panel: materials/ingredients list + care or usage notes
Seal sticker: contact info inside a round sticker
Footer with a stitched (dashed) bottom edge

anchor.name: Big stamp
anchor.description: One large circular rubber stamp (40vw) with the name around the ring and a linocut vignette in the centre.

type.name: Caveat + Alegreya Sans
type.notes: Caveat for handwritten labels, prices and titles at 28–72px; rotate whole labels -2° to +2°, never individual letters; never for paragraphs. Alegreya Sans body 17/1.6. Prices in Caveat 700 with a smaller currency sign.

palette.name: Chalkboard
palette.usage: Green-black board; chalk-white handwriting and body; yellow chalk for prices, pink chalk for one highlight per section; panels a step lighter like a cleaner patch of board.

density.description: 大留白，一屏只讲一件事；正文行长 60–68 字符（中文 30–36 字）。

motion.name: Tag swing
motion.description: Hovering a hanging tag swings it from its hole: 0° → 4° → -2° → 0°.
motion.reduced: No swing; the tag text gets a hand-drawn underline.

motif.name: Linocut vignettes
motif.description: Small one-colour SVG illustrations with gouged-line texture (solid shapes, white carving lines), depicting the actual products (bread, cup, leaf, needle).

surface.name: Chalk dust
surface.description: A board with faint smudged eraser marks.
surface.css: background-image: radial-gradient(ellipse at 30% 40%, rgba(255,255,255,.05), transparent 60%), radial-gradient(ellipse at 75% 70%, rgba(255,255,255,.04), transparent 55%);

twist.description: 一个巨大的单字、单字母或单数字作为首屏视觉锚点（占视口高度 40% 以上）。

concept.zh: 长篇杂志特稿：大号首字下沉、标题下的导语、署名行、多栏正文、打断栏位的引语和页脚页码。节奏来自栏宽、栏间细线和标题字号的大落差——是印刷杂志的版面，而不是大片留白的“生活方式”网页。
concept.en: The long-form magazine feature: a big drop cap, a deck under the headline, a byline, multi-column body text, a pull quote breaking the columns and folios at the foot. Rhythm comes from column measure, hairline column rules and dramatic headline scale — a printed magazine spread, not a whitespace-heavy lifestyle site.

references: The New Yorker feature pages (Rea Irvin display, Caslon body)
Harper’s Bazaar under Alexey Brodovitch (1934–58)
Esquire under Harold Hayes and George Lois (1960s)
The New York Times Magazine redesign by Matt Willey (2015)
London Review of Books

tokens.grid: 12 columns, 18px gutter, max 1240px; body in 3 columns of 4 grid columns (≈ 22em) on desktop, 2 on tablet, 1 on mobile (column-count with column-rule); 24px baseline; opening spreads split 6 + 6.
tokens.border: Column rules 1px var(--rule) (column-rule); folio rule 1px full width; pull quotes with a 3px accent rule above and 1px rule below; section breaks as a centred ornament (❧) or a 3em rule.

must: Body text runs in multiple columns on desktop at a 45–75 character measure.
The feature opens with headline, deck and byline, and the body starts with a drop cap.
At least one pull quote taken verbatim from the provided facts or body text.
Folios or a running footer with issue and section information.
mustNot: No Kinfolk-style minimal lifestyle layout: no expanses of beige whitespace around one centred paragraph.
No card grids of article teasers with rounded thumbnails.
No real magazine mastheads (The New Yorker, Vogue…) used as branding.

voice.description: 博物馆藏品标签：名称、年代、材质、尺寸，最后一句冷静的注解。
devices: 名称 / 年代 / 材质 三行
voice.example: 乡村面包，2026。小麦、水、盐、九年酵种。直径 22 cm。

layout.name: Opening spread
layout.description: A two-page opener: left page a full-height image or a giant typographic headline, right page deck, byline and the first columns with a drop cap.
layout.grid: 6 + 6 columns at ≥ 1024px; left half headline or image at 100vh; right half: deck across 4 columns, body in 2 columns × 3; folio row at the foot of both halves.
structure: Rubric (section name) top-left in small caps, folio number
Left page: headline at 8–12vw or full-bleed image with a credit line
Right page: deck/standfirst in italic, byline “By … · Photographs by …”
Body starts with a 4-line drop cap and runs in 2–3 columns
Pull quote spanning 2 columns mid-body; end mark ■ or “Continued on p. 74”

anchor.name: Giant headline
anchor.description: The first screen is the headline at 10–14vw over 2–3 lines with deck and byline beneath; no image.

type.name: Bodoni Moda + Libre Baskerville
type.notes: Bodoni Moda 400 italic and 700 roman mixed inside one headline at 72–160px (optical sizing on so hairlines stay sharp), leading 0.92; deck Bodoni Moda 400 at 24px. Body Libre Baskerville 400 at 16px/26px, ragged-right. Bylines uppercase 11px with 0.2em tracking in Libre Baskerville 700. 6-line drop cap in Bodoni Moda 700.

palette.name: Weekly white
palette.usage: Black on white for ≥ 95% of the page; red (accent) only for the rubric, the drop cap and the end mark ■; navy (accent2) for links and illustration line work; panel for sidebars.

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Page turn
motion.description: Moving between spreads turns the page: the outgoing page rotates −180° around the spine (rotateY, perspective 1600px) while the next spread is revealed beneath.
motion.reduced: Cut directly to the next spread.

motif.name: Drop cap
motif.description: A 3–6 line drop cap in the display face opening the feature and each major section, aligned to the baseline grid.

surface.name: Coated magazine stock
surface.description: Bright smooth paper with no texture; image areas at full saturation.

twist.description: 全页没有任何 box-shadow / drop-shadow；层级只靠边框、色块和留白。

concept.zh: 索特萨斯与杜·帕斯奎尔的孟菲斯小组：弯弯曲曲的粗线、水磨石斑点、彩纸屑图案、黑白小方格，粉彩和原色正面相撞。家具像玩具，图形像在开派对——故意的不和谐，但每块颜色都边缘清楚。
concept.en: The Memphis Group of Sottsass and du Pasquier: squiggles, terrazzo flecks, confetti prints, black-and-white grids, pastels colliding with primaries. Furniture like toys, graphics like a party — deliberate clashes, but every colour field has a crisp outline.

references: Ettore Sottsass, Carlton room divider (1981)
Nathalie du Pasquier, laminate and textile patterns for Memphis (1981–1987)
Peter Shire, Bel Air armchair (1982)
Christoph Radl, Memphis catalogues and posters (1981–1988)
Ettore Sottsass, “Bacterio” print for Abet Laminati (1978)

tokens.grid: 12 columns, 16px gutter, 32px margins; coloured blocks may be offset by one column or rotated ±3–8°, but text inside a block is always straight and aligned.
tokens.radius: 0 for laminate blocks; 50% for discs; half- and quarter-discs via one- or two-corner radii (e.g. border-radius: 0 0 0 100%).
tokens.border: 3px solid ink outline on every coloured block; patterns meet along 3px ink lines.
tokens.shadow: Hard offsets only: 8px 8px 0 var(--ink) (or a pattern-filled offset block). Never blurred.

must: At least three different pattern fills (grid, squiggle, terrazzo/confetti) appear on the page.
Every coloured block has a visible ink outline or a hard offset — crisp edges.
At least one pastel and one primary colour collide in the same view.
Body copy always sits on a solid panel.
mustNot: No gradients and no glows — Memphis is flat laminate.
No synthwave clichés: neon grids to the horizon, chrome lettering, sunsets.
No blurred shadows; only hard offsets.

voice.description: 访谈稿：问句短，答句是当事人的原话风格，具体、口语、有细节。
voice.example: 问：为什么周一休息？答：酵种也要歇一天。

layout.name: Pattern patchwork
layout.description: A collage of rectangular patches, each with a different fill (grid, squiggle, terrazzo, solid), with paper-coloured content panels pinned on top.
layout.grid: CSS grid 6 × n, 0 gap, patches span 1–3 cells; content panels span 2–4 cells and overlap patch borders by 16px.
structure: Patchwork hero: 6–8 patterned patches with the title panel overlapping three of them
Facts as tilted label panels (rotated ±4°)
Schedule/table on a black-and-white grid ground
Footer row of patches with contact

anchor.name: Squiggle title
anchor.description: A huge title with a 12px squiggle underline and two geometric props (disc, triangle) touching the letters.

type.name: Chango + Questrial
type.notes: Chango (wide, heavy, toy-like) for titles at 40–96px, mixed case, line-height 1.05. Questrial body 16/1.6; captions 13px uppercase tracking 0.1em.

palette.name: Laminate yellow
palette.usage: Bright laminate-yellow ground; red and green blocks; white outlined panels carry all text; black grids and squiggles.

lines.verdict: large text / UI marks only (≥24px or bold ≥19px)

density.description: 常规阅读节奏；区块之间用明确的分隔（线、色块或编号），不靠空白硬撑。

motion.name: Pattern shuffle
motion.description: Hovering a patch cycles its fill through three patterns in hard steps.
motion.reduced: The pattern changes once, without stepping.

motif.name: Squiggles
motif.description: Thick (6–10px) wavy SVG strokes with round caps in ink or accent, scattered at ±30° across panels; at most 5 per screen.

surface.name: Grid laminate
surface.description: Black grid on paper for one large shape per screen.
surface.css: background-color: var(--paper); background-image: linear-gradient(var(--ink) 2px, transparent 2px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--ink) 2px, transparent 2px); background-size: 14px 14px;

twist.description: 至少一处使用竖排文字（中文 writing-mode: vertical-rl）或旋转 90° 的标签作为结构元素。

trace.note: primary branch (or its family) already used in this roll; walked forward 2 step(s)
